name: Domitiem
source:
A senior spirit who has a contract with [url=/c111180]Ukon Tarivana[/url]. Domitiem is a straightforward and inflexible warrior who is obsessed with his role. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.prot.co.jp/ps2/polyphonica2/index.html]PS2 edition's official website[/url].]
